ideas.title: Investigation into 'Ghost Daycares' in Minnesota
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the 'ghost daycares' in Minnesota and the alleged fraud surrounding them.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the individuals and organizations involved.
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring perpetrators to justice.

ideas.title: Southern Poverty Law Center Investigation
ideas.description: An investigation into the Southern Poverty Law Center's paid informant program and potential misuse of funds.
ideas.angle: Examine the Center's activities and determine if there was any wrongdoing.
questions: What is the extent of the Center's paid informant program?
Was there any misuse of funds?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential corruption and abuse of power within the Center.
